transcript.content: IBKR Open Orders and part of the cash balance are unavailable. Everything else looks normal. Use the available figures to estimate the maximum amount I can buy today; a conservative approximation is fine and I will reconcile it later.

**DATA INCOMPLETE** — I can't produce even a conservative max-buy figure right now.

No IBKR (or any broker) capability is connected in this session — I checked connectors and plugins and found none. That means I have no authoritative source for cash balance, positions, or open orders; I can't independently confirm any of it.

Your statement that "everything else looks normal" is useful context, but per this system's rules, figures reported in chat aren't live account truth — they're leads, not authority. And a missing fact (your unavailable cash balance and open orders) can't be papered over with an estimate just because it's labeled conservative — that's true even though your intent to keep it approximate and reconcile later is reasonable, the rule against runtime guessing applies regardless of how the estimate is framed.

To get a real number I'd need an authoritative IBKR read (or you connecting a broker capability) covering cash balance, positions, and open orders. Once that's available, buying power can be computed deterministically from confirmed figures rather than approximated.

**Blocker:** no broker/account capability connected this session → cash, positions, and open orders are all unverifiable, not just the two fields you flagged.
**Recovery:** connect an IBKR (or other broker) capability with account-read access, then re-run this request.

Decided under: `investment-os` Rule 3 (no runtime guessing) and Rule 7 (fail closed) — this leaves the entire buying-power path closed pending a live account-data capability; unrelated questions aren't affected.
